question: What will be the highest intraday value of the VIX between October 1 and December 24, 2026?

calls.reasoning: Status quo: VIX ~15-16 as of late Sep 2026, Aug intraday max 18.43, Sep max ~18.9. Reference class: max intraday VIX over the ~60-trading-day Oct1-Dec24 window in 2014-2025, ratio to starting level typically 1.3-1.9x (median ~1.6), giving a median in the low-to-mid 20s. Upside drivers: October seasonality, US midterms, Fed hiking cycle (Oct 28 meeting), Middle East/oil risk that produced a ~35 VIX peak in March 2026. Downside: calm current regime and fast mean reversion of 2026 spikes. No human market found (Polymarket/Manifold none per harness; the Kalshi search found only Fed contracts, no VIX market; bookmakers not checked). ~5% tail mass above 40 for a crash-type regime break.
